content.short: Plasma's spot and perpetuals hub for trading USDT pairs with zero gas and up to 60x leverage.
content.description: Ionex puts spot swaps and perpetual futures in one non-custodial venue on Plasma, where traders pay no gas on USDT. A solver network brings in liquidity sourced from major exchanges, and orders execute in under a second with hotkeys and advanced order types for active traders. Perps go up to 60x, and its INX token trades against XPL.
